relationships.subject: LV-siSCN9A
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared with LV-SC group, the Nav1.7 mRNA and protein expression in LV-siSCN9A group was significantly decreased, and the difference was statistically significant (P < 0.05).

relationships.subject: LV-siSCN9A
relationships.evidence_quote: The CGRP expression of spinal dorsal horn in LV-siSCN9A group was significantly decreased compared with that in the LV-SC group, and the difference was statistically significant (P < 0.05) (Figure 10).

relationships.subject: LV-siSCN9A
relationships.evidence_quote: compared with the model group, the expressions of NLRP3, ASIC3, and CaMK2α in the spinal cord of the LV-siSCN9A group were significantly decreased (P < 0.05)

relationships.subject: LV-siSCN9A
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared with the LV-SC group, the MWT and TWL of each detection time in the LV-siSCN9A group were significantly increased after modeling, and the difference was statistically significant (P < 0.05).

relationships.subject: Nav1.7
relationships.evidence_quote: It was shown that the expression of Nav1.7 was mainly on CGRP positive cells.

key_findings: Vincristine increased Nav1.7 mRNA/protein and lowered MWT/TWL; DRG injection of LV-siSCN9A reversed these and reduced dorsal horn CGRP.
LV-siSCN9A also lowered spinal NLRP3, ASIC3 and CaMK2α.
